about: Mississippi state grant calls entered by hand from each agency's own page: Mississippi has no state catalog here (docs/state-coverage.md), so this is not a statewide list. grantmatch/local.py checks this file and turns each entry into a Mississippi program record; the weekly page watcher rereads every page. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date.

programs.title: Sexual Risk Avoidance Education (SRAE) Program request for proposals
programs.agency: Mississippi Department of Human Services, Division of Youth Services
programs.objectives: Sexual risk avoidance education and supportive youth services for youth ages 10 to 19 across Mississippi, including youth in the community, schools, juvenile justice, foster care and underserved rural areas.
programs.who: Qualified 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations or governmental entities.
programs.application: Find the request for proposals in the open procurements table on the Department's page.
programs.award: No amount is given in the table.
programs.deadlines: The open procurements table gives December 10, 2026 as the expiration date.
programs.source_note: The table is filled by script, so the weekly page check can't see changes to it: check it in a browser. The request for proposals, a PDF with the exact due time, wasn't opened.

programs.title: AmeriCorps State Formula Grants, FY 2027
programs.agency: Volunteer Mississippi, the Mississippi Commission for Volunteer Service
programs.objectives: Grants for programs that put AmeriCorps members to work on community needs. Organizations that don't already manage AmeriCorps State and National funding may apply only for a planning grant.
programs.who: Public or private nonprofit organizations, including faith-based and community organizations, institutions of higher education, government entities, labor organizations, partnerships and consortia, and tribes.
programs.application: Read the notice of funding and the application instructions on Volunteer Mississippi's page; formula applications go through the America Learns grant system.
programs.award: The amount isn't stated on the page.
programs.match: 24% in the first three-year funding period, cash or in-kind
programs.subjects: AmeriCorps; National service; Volunteers; Community development

programs.title: Creative Aging Grant, Round 1
programs.objectives: Skills-based arts learning for adults 55 and over, led by teaching artists.
programs.who: Mississippi-based organizations with 501(c)(3) status, or units of local government, libraries and county or municipal agencies. Individuals, K-12 schools and colleges can't apply.
programs.application: Apply online in the Arts Commission's E-Grant system. First-time applicants are encouraged to talk to the Commission first.
programs.award: $2,000 to $8,000. Up to $24,000 in total is available in Round 1.
programs.match: One to one, cash and in-kind (in-kind up to half of the match)
programs.deadlines: Round 1 runs February 1 to March 1, 2027. Round 2 is April 1 to May 1, 2027; rounds 3 and 4 depend on funding.
